capabilities: Show live WPM in the status bar
Track current-document stats (words, characters, average WPM, active time, bursts)
Aggregate vault-wide and per-note typing statistics
Count active typing time with a pause grace window
Filter non-typing edits such as deletes, undo/redo, paste, and bulk insertions
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README's gallery section references images not included in the text.
motivation: The author wanted typing stats based on active typing bursts rather than the naive calculation of total words divided by total time a document is open.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in typing speed tracking, and naive word-count-over-elapsed-time measures are diluted by idle time with a note open.
summary: Real-time WPM monitor that shows typing speed in the status bar and aggregates per-note and vault-wide typing statistics.
